data.name: Hell's Corruption
data.description: You can cause a creature to become more susceptible to corruption as a melee touch attack. Creatures touched take a -2 penalty on all saving throws and must roll all opposed skill checks twice, taking the worse result. This effect lasts for %1 rounds. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|max(DomainLVL/2,1)|DomainEvilTimes
